title: Virginia DEQ APG-576 Diesel Generator Permitting Guidance
summary: Revised APG-576 defines Virginia DEQ's minimum permitting approach for emergency and non-emergency diesel generator sets, including data-center-specific presumptive control and testing expectations.
key_findings: The revised guidance became effective April 9, 2026.
It adds data-center-specific presumptive best-available-control-technology and performance-testing sections.
DEQ may impose more stringent requirements where air-quality or other requirements demand them.
why_it_matters: It sharpens the environmental-control gate for onsite generation used by data centers.
ftfn_relevance: Turns a general permit rail into a named compliance standard.
Supports comparison of issued permits with later testing and compliance records.
Keeps permit approval separate from generator operation.
evidence_limits: Guidance is not a facility-specific permit or compliance result.
It does not establish equipment construction, testing, emissions, or data-center operation.
